query: What is Spotify's most recently reported number of monthly active users, and its most recently reported number of full-time employees? Give each figure with its reporting period and the primary source.
report: As of the third quarter of 2026, Spotify reported 788 million monthly active users [1][2][3]. Additionally, the company reported a global workforce of 7,284 full-time employees as of the end of September 2026 [2][3][4]. These figures were provided in the company's Q3 2026 earnings report published on October 22, 2026 [1][2][3].
